The Meridian 10 opens in a moment. You have a cash account, a newswire that is right more often than it is honest, and three funds who would very much like to beat you. Trade all 240 sessions. Do not blow up.

Read the tape

Prices move on ticks. Macro news drags the whole board; earnings and FDA rulings gap single names overnight.

How to play

The clock

Six ticks make a session. Space pauses. Fees, borrow costs and margin interest settle overnight.

Orders

Market orders only, and they cost you: a bid/ask spread plus slippage that grows with your size against a name's liquidity.

Brackets

Set a stop-loss and take-profit percentage before you enter. They fire on any tick, including overnight gaps.

Margin call

If equity falls under 25% of gross exposure, the desk force-liquidates your biggest position at whatever the screen says.

Halts

Any name that moves 20% in a session trips the circuit breaker and stops trading until the next open. You are stuck with it.

Keys

1–9,0 pick a ticker. B buy, S sell, H short, C cover, Space pause.
